fillHelp: Interpolate gaps up to 1,000 m using existing heights. Existing values are kept. You can undo the change.
fillLimit: There are too many route points or elevation samples to fill the gaps. Open a route with fewer points and try again.
fillFailed: Couldn’t fill the elevation gaps. Try again or close this window to continue editing.
onlineHelp: Get terrain heights and compare them with the current profile before replacing it.
noKnownHeights: At least one known height is needed for interpolation. Use online terrain data instead.
importFillable: Elevation gaps detected: {gaps}. All can be filled using the existing heights.
importNoHeights: This route has no known elevations to interpolate from. Get online terrain data to create a complete profile.
importNeedsReplacement: Elevation gaps detected: {gaps}. Unfillable gaps: {remaining}. We recommend replacing the full profile with online terrain data.
importReplacementHelp: Gaps over 1,000 m or next to conflicting heights cannot be interpolated. Fetch terrain heights, review the preview, then confirm replacement of all elevations. The change can be undone.
importLaterHelp: You can continue editing and return to Elevation tools later.
